revision: Explicit existing flat entrypoints/call setup only; exact five saved NPZ SHA and partitions unchanged. No new Python implementation or arrays in Git.

reconstruction.input_gate: Verify all ten approved public input byte SHA privately before discovery. Preserve CSV row/column order; do not change or upload raw data/arrays.

discovery.hash_definition: Returned hashes are pd.util.hash_pandas_object(train[spec[features]],index=False).to_numpy(dtype=uint64). Features exclude ID/target and preserve original test-column order. Use returned hashes, not a replacement grouping.

reconstruction.split_import: from automl_evaluation import choose_validation, make_time_split, make_split

regression.definition: Pinned observation_values sorts the original numeric periods; tr is original positions with time<cut, va positions with time==cut for offsets0/1/2. No future rows or reordering.

classification.definition: Use exact pinned make_split: duplicate_feature_rate>0.05 selects StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=min(5,min unique feature-hash groups/class),shuffle=True,random_state=seed), take fold0. No semantic-entity reinterpretation, reseed, sorting or rowwise replacement. Frozen task has no semantic time/group candidate.

serialization.dtype_and_order: Preserve original ordered integer arrays returned by splitter. Recorded host arrays are int64; do not sort/cast/reorder to force a desired answer. Compare full NPZ byte SHA to each saved_npz_sha256.
serialization.format: Uncompressed NumPy savez, not savez_compressed; no additional metadata/members.

reconstruction.version_provenance: Installed distribution metadata only read during preparation; no NumPy/pandas/sklearn import, splitter call, dataset read or fit.
reconstruction.mismatch_policy: A missing dependency or any exact-byte mismatch is blocked with actual reason and null metric; do not generate alternative cuts. Source reasoning is not cross-host binary reproduction proof.
